caption.text:
🎨 OPEN CALL FOR ARTISTS | ICH 2027

What does Realizing India’s Aspirations mean to you?

The India Conference at Harvard 2027 invites artists of Indian origin, across disciplines and geographies, to interpret, question, and reimagine this year’s theme through art.

From traditional practices to contemporary experimentation, we welcome creative expressions that explore India’s identities, ambitions, contradictions, and possibilities.

Selected works will be showcased at Harvard University during the conference on February 27–28, 2027, and/or featured in our digital archive, bringing diverse artistic perspectives into conversation with leaders, thinkers, and changemakers shaping India’s future.

🖼️ Who can apply? Artists of Indian origin, based in India or abroad, at any career stage. Individuals and collectives are welcome.

🎭 Mediums: All physical, digital, and performance-based art forms.

📅 Application deadline: January 3, 2027 (rolling applications)

🔗 Apply through the link in our bio!

We look forward to seeing India’s aspirations through your eyes.

#IndiaConferenceAtHarvard #ICH2027 #RealizingIndiasAspirations #OpenCallForArtists
